questions.question: In the following question, four groups of three numbers are given. In each group the second and third number are related to the first number by a Logic/Rule/Relation. Three are similar on basis of same Logic/Rule/Relation. Select the odd one out from the given alternatives.
questions.solution:
The logic followed is here is:-

**Second number = First number × 4 + 1**

**Third number = First number × 2 + 1**

In (22, 89, 45)

(22 × 4 + 1) → 88 + 1 = 89

(22 × 2 + 1) → 44 + 1 = 45

In (15, 61, 31)

(15 × 4 + 1) → 60 + 1 = 61

(15 × 2 + 1) → 30 + 1 = 31

In (12, 49, 25)

(12 × 4 + 1) → 48 +1 = 49

(12 × 2 + 1) → 24 + 1 = 25

But,

**In (13, 52, 27)**

**(13 × 4 + 1) → 53 ≠ 52**

**(13 × 2 + 1) → 27**

As can be seen clearly that the odd pair is (13, 52, 27) as it does not follow the logic.

Hence, the correct answer is **"(13, 52, 27)".**

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by four conclusions numbered I, II, III and IV. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly know facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow (s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some bulbs are tubelights.

No tubelight is switch.

No bulb is watch.

**Conclusions:**

I. No watch is tubelight.

II. Some bulbs are switches.

III. Some tubelights are bulbs.

IV. No watch is bulb.

options.text: Either Conclusion I or III follows.
Only Conclusion II and III follow.
Only Conclusion I and III follow.
Only Conclusion III and IV follow.

questions.solution:
Drawing the Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b88402fc2c394164fd21859c3240420376c7d25457508de950de44747a49e41.png] 

Conclusion 1: No watch is tubelight → False (It is possible but not definite)

Conclusion 2: Some bulbs are switches → False (It is possible but not definite)

Conclusion 4: No watch is bulb → True

Hence, ‘Only conclusion III and IV follow’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully and decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement.

**Statement:**

Of all the ice creams brands manufactured in India, ‘Amulya’ brand has the highest sales since last five years. The sales of other ice cream brands fluctuate every year.

**Conclusions:**

I. The taste of ‘Amulya’ ice creams is popular among Indian residents.

II. The sales of all other Indian brands of ice creams are known.

options.text: Neither conclusions I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
Given,

Statement: Of all the ice creams brands manufactured in India, ‘Amulya’ brand has the highest sales since last five years. The sales of other ice cream brands fluctuate every year.

Conclusions:

I. **The taste of ‘Amulya’ ice creams is popular among Indian residents.**

 
• The statement mentions that Amulya has the highest sales for the past five years.
 
• High sales could be due to multiple factors such as marketing or distribution.
 
• Conclusion I is an assumption regarding taste that is not directly supported by the statement.
 
• Therefore, this conclusion does not logically follow.

**II. The sales of all other Indian brands of ice creams are known.**

 
• The statement mentions that the sales of other ice cream brands fluctuate every year.
 
• This indicates that there is data available regarding the sales of the other brands, for it to be known that they fluctuate.
 
• Therefore, it can be inferred that the sales of all other Indian brands of ice creams are known.

So, Only conclusion II follows..

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

8 - 9 + 24 × 63 = 33
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e10e3be1476caf1bd7e2e109842e7c57ce86da0c54b1b539e233e4e6a7748a44.png] 

**Given:**

8 - 9 + 24 × 63 = 33

**(1) × and -**

⇒ 8 - 9 + 24 × 63 = 33

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ __**8 × 9**__ + 24 - 63 = 33

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**72 + 24**__ - 63

⇒ 96 - 63 = **33**

⇒ LHS = RHS

Here, the equation is **satisfied.**

**(2) = and +**

⇒ 8 - 9 + 24 × 63 = 33

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ __**8 - 9**__ = __**24 × 63**__ + 33

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ (-1) = 1512 + 33

⇒ (-1) = 1545

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

**(3) - and =**

⇒ 8 - 9 + 24 × 63 = 33

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 8 = 9 + __**24 × 63**__ - 33

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 8 = __**9 + 1512**__ - 33

⇒ 8 = 1521 - 33

⇒ 8 = 1488

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

**(4) - and +**

⇒ 8 - 9 + 24 × 63 = 33

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 8 + 9 - __**24 × 63**__ = 33

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**8 + 9**__ - 1512

⇒ 17 - 1512

⇒ (-1495) = 33

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
